interpretation_policy.compulsory_classes_are_not_talent_or_int: Attendance, course duration, or parent expectation never become evidence of aptitude or child interest.
interpretation_policy.score_handling: Do not subtract exposure or alter a child's raw response score. Report observed performance separately from prior-exposure context and child-reported interest.
interpretation_policy.deployment: Use context for item-family sensitivity, stratification, and later differential-item-functioning analysis only after the design and sample are approved; do not invent correction weights now.
